page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor using the x86_64 architecture, running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and it does not include GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance tradeoff between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 10% to 25% tier, and single-threaded gzip compression registering as poor. However, the 16 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, as demonstrated by middle-tier results in multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory read and write bandwidths also perform within the average range, though the overall Passmark memory score is weak.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1ne.4xlarge offers a dedicated hardware profile suitable for workloads that benefit from parallel processing without requiring high single-thread performance or local storage. The instance is well-suited for multi-threaded decompression, static web serving, Redis key-value operations, and moderate software compilation tasks. It can also handle light-to-medium language model inference tasks, though it is not optimized for large-scale AI or memory-intensive databases.
